camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi CreateHybridCloudGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test --LoadBalanceIp '3.3.3.3' --GroupType protect --InstanceId 'waf-cn-n6w000x52m' --ClusterId 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates a node group in a Hybrid Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) cluster
description_zh: 创建混合云集群节点组信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-hybrid-cloud-group --instance-id waf-cn-n6w000x52m --cluster-id 1 --group-name test --group-type protect --load-balance-ip 3.3.3.3 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHybridCloudGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the node group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node group. Valid values:

protect: a protection node group that processes traffic filtering.

control: a control node group that manages cluster configurations.

storage: a storage node group that stores logs and data.

controlStorage: a node group that serves as both control and storage
parameters.help_zh:
节点组类型。取值范围如下：
protect：防护。

control：管控。

storage：存储。

controlStorage：管控＆存储
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the load balancer that is associated with the node group
parameters.name: load_balance_ip

parameters.help_en: The remarks on the node group. You can use this parameter to add a brief description for the node group
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The location code of the region where the node group resides. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City
parameters.help_zh: 节点所在区域。参数说明：运营商-大洲-城市
parameters.name: location_code

parameters.help_en: The back-to-origin mark of the node group. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City, which is used to identify the origin of back-to-origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 节点所在区域。参数说明：运营商-大洲-城市
parameters.name: back_source_mark

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The ID of the created node group
